name: Example: Describing a Triangular Matrix
problem:
How can we best describe the following matrix? 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075464/assets/fc2ed708d717844ca73b7ecbfd8467923fad091ae524153350e7e2fb3df1ea4e.png)
worked_solution:
Notice that $A$ is a matrix for which all entries above the diagonal are $0$'s:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14075464/assets/5260137f2dbf20b44400659be8467da333ff228e5bff323465f920a9505ee5f2.png)

Therefore, it is a lower triangular matrix.

It is not an upper triangular matrix or a diagonal matrix since there is a non-zero element below the diagonal: $a_{21}=6 \neq 0.$
